system.description:
False Allies: Make a Power Roll against a creature. On a success spend a Hope to mask your ship as an ally of the targeted creature.

Fake Identities: Make a Power Roll (14). On a success you can Spend a Stress to temporarily change the signature of your ship.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
